evidence.detail: Tournament-only toggle is a separate <a href> button rendered by server-side mustache, outside the JSX table; it navigates to a different URL rather than updating table state
data-tournament-only is baked in as a data-attribute by the server; the JSX table receives it as a prop, not as mutable state
tournamentOnly and leagueOnly are props (from server-rendered data-attributes), not internal state — the component cannot toggle them without a page reload
Same server-side data-attribute pattern in cardtable; at least 3 JSX table types (decktable, cardtable, metagame) would need the switch added

triage.notes: Requires moving tournamentOnly from server-rendered prop to DataManager internal state, adding a UI toggle in the JSX component, updating all call sites (livedecktable, livecardtable, metagame mustache templates), and removing the now-redundant server-side toggle from buttons.mustache. Well beyond 150 lines.
